sentences.en: Feeling the house shake, I ran out into the street.
sentences.zh: 感觉房子在震动，我跑到了街上。

sentences.en: The bus stopped suddenly in the middle of the street.
sentences.zh: 公共汽车突然在街道中间停了下来。

sentences.en: Never go across the street without looking for cars first.
sentences.zh: 过马路之前一定要先看看有没有车。

senses.zh: 街道，马路；街道（作为地址的一部分）；（某一行业的）街，区
